decision: Three flat tenant-owned tables (application, registry_def, record) in a fixed parent->child chain enforced structurally by composite tenant_id-leading FKs, no discriminator tables, no inheritance. Each follows T-0013 convention verbatim (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL leading PK, ENABLE+FORCE RLS default-DENY on choros.tenant_id, withTenant access, scoped uniqueness) and is ADDED to T-0013's known_tenant_tables apparatus - no new isolation code-path. Hierarchy pinned by FKs not logic: registry_def(tenant_id,application_id)->application(tenant_id,id), record(tenant_id,registry_id)->registry_def(tenant_id,id). Registry shape is data not schema: registry_def.record_schema jsonb (JSON Schema draft-07+) and record.data validated app-layer at write time (no registry_type discriminator). System registries are registry_def rows with is_system=true (set at tenant-init, gates delete). Identity is immutable UUID; slug mutable+scoped-unique so renames never break grants. ADR fixes ONLY the grant-binding surface: three stable UUID-only ResourceRef shapes T-0018 consumes - not grant entities/semantics/resolution.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: DDL on every registry create/field-add; explodes migration + known_tenant_tables surface; per-tenant-unbounded RLS/FK auditing; defeats NF-2.

rejected_alternatives.option: Single polymorphic node table with level enum + self-FK parent_id
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Self-FK cannot structurally forbid illegal shapes; becomes runtime discipline not structure - the anti-pattern T-0013 rejects.
Two entity types for one concept; system registries must be equally grantable/listable; boolean flag is minimal.
No MVP behavior branches on type; speculative; only real differentiation is is_system boolean.
Postgres core has no JSON-Schema validator; needs non-standard pg_jsonschema. App-layer keeps DB standard and matches draft exactly.
Violates T-0013 scoped-uniqueness and decorative-tenant_id trap; two tenants must independently own a slug.
Slug rename would silently re-target/orphan grants. Grants bind to immutable UUIDs (NF-3).

contracts: withTenant(tenantId, fn) - inherited from T-0013; only sanctioned access path for all three tables; no raw query outside withTenant
type ResourceRef = application|registry|record discriminated union of stable UUID-only references
appRef/registryRef/recordRef constructors - side-effect-free, built from existing NOT NULL columns; perform NO authorization decision (T-0018)
validateRecordData(recordSchema, data) -> ok|errors - app-layer JSON-Schema validation on every record create+update BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE; fail-closed
deleteApplication(ref) - throws HasChildrenError if registry_def children exist
deleteRegistry(ref) - throws SystemRegistryProtectedError if is_system, else HasChildrenError if record children
provisionSystemRegistry - internal-only sets is_system=true; tenant-admin createRegistry always writes is_system=false
